releaseNotes: Restores the full-screen Setup experience for the first offline installation only. The installer prepares its checklist and storage during the ECG splash, then the Setup screen appears immediately after the splash.

The first-install package is downloaded and verified before the onboarding scripts and question-bank data are loaded, preventing them from competing with the installer for network and startup resources.

After the first install, the app opens from its saved local package. Repairs and updates stay in the background with a compact progress chip; automatic update checks run every 48 hours and Settings can trigger a manual check.
Keeps the To Me verified updater with resumable downloads, per-file size and SHA-256 validation, staged updates, and one safe restart after verified changes are committed.
Preserves the existing iOS cache namespace shbace-medical-offline-v2, IndexedDB database shbace-medical-offline-state-v1, student data, iOS icon, and onboarding screens.
